snippet.title: Total Chaos | Gameplay Trailer | Play The Demo Now!
snippet.description:
FREE Demo on Steam: ► http://PlayTotalChaos.com
Total Chaos is a brutal survival horror game set in the decaying remains of Fort Oasis, a long-abandoned mining colony where nightmares come to life and reality crumbles.

Explore nine dread-soaked chapters, uncover cryptic clues, and survive hallucination-fueled horrors. Scavenge, craft makeshift weapons, and face terrifying enemies that adapt to your every move. With limited resources and a punishing inventory system, every item and every decision matters.

🔪 Craft to survive
👁️ Face freakish foes
📜 Uncover dark secrets
🎒 Manage every resource
🕯️ Experience pure atmospheric dread

⚠️ A free demo is available now on Steam. Total Chaos launches this summer on PC. VR support arrives post-launch.
